critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext initial state reads localStorage during useState initializer which runs on client only (fine for CRA, but could cause FOUC on first paint — consider inlined script in index.html to set 'light' class before React mounts to avoid flash).
Several console 401 errors appear during unauthenticated navigation (admin auth check endpoint). Not a bug, but consider suppressing or using 204 for 'not authenticated' probe to reduce noise.
HeroFrame badge path is hardcoded textLength='286' with lengthAdjust='spacing'. Works but brittle if copy changes; add a comment or compute dynamically.
